bio: Part of the Hotel Casamar, this family-run (now in its seventies) property which has been passed down from the parents to their children, boasts an elevated location with fine views of the beach. The focus of chef Quim Casellas is on traditional and Mediterranean cuisine that skilfully incorporates innovative touches and adds flavours from the local surroundings to his recipes. The à la carte, which includes a special section of rice dishes as well as other enticing options such as white asparagus with a creamy hollandaise sauce, aged pork rib, and puffed rice and caviar, is complemented by two menus (Punta d'en Blanc and Degustación)....
